title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to: A. EXECUTE Modification No. 4 to Communications Support and Outreach Services Bench Contract Nos. PS85397000…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0778, Contract]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to: 

A.  EXECUTE Modification No. 4 to Communications Support and Outreach Services Bench Contract Nos. PS85397000 through PS85397015 to increase the cumulative contract value in an amount Not-To-Exceed (NTE) $1,500,000, increasing the contract value from $50,000,000 to $51,500,000; and 

B.  EXECUTE individual contract modifications within the Board-approved contract modification authority.
